Louisiana man David Danserau was arrested June 9 and booked on 500 counts of felony Possession of Child Sexual Abuse Material depicting kids under age 13 and 50 counts of felony Sexual Abuse of an Animal. 

ICE @HSINewOrleans, in coordination with the 22nd Judicial District Special Victims Unit Task Force and local law enforcement partners, arrested Danserau after a disturbing cyber tip led to discovering extensive child sexual abuse material and evidence of sexual abuse to an animal.

HSI’s extensive experience with child exploitation cases made it uniquely qualified to provide forensic supoort in the ongoing investigation.

If convicted, Danserau faces a 10 to 40 years in prison per count.

“June is Internet Safety Month, and this case is an important reminder that predators are present every day on the same online platforms used by children in our community,” said Acting Special Agent in Charge Matt Wright of HSI New Orleans. “I encourage parents to review the steps they are taking to keep their children safe online and to report anything that does not seem right.”

➡️Parents and caregivers can get help protecting kids and teens online from our partners at https://t.co/CCfnnYKy3m.

Shalond White, a U.S. citizen, began her one-year federal prison sentence for assaulting federal officers.

During a traffic stop in January, Memphis Safe Task Force officers discovered White had an active arrest warrant out and asked her to step out of the vehicle.

👉White verbally refused to exit the vehicle.

👉When officers opened the door of her vehicle to physically remove her, she kicked one of them in the thigh and struck another in the shoulder.  

👉Then, she spit on an officer.

The case was investigated by ICE @HSI_HQ, and she was charged with two counts of assault on a federal officer. She pleaded guilty on April 24 and was sentenced June 9.

Police in Sevierville, TN, arrested Enrique Estrada-Martinez March 30 in connection with the pedestrian death of a 73-year-old man.

Enrique Estrada-Martinez was the country illegally and not licensed to operate a motor vehicle in the U.S. when he allegedly struck Henry Smith of Kentucky and left the scene. Smith was found dead on the road.

He’s charged locally with HIT & RUN CAUSING DEATH and DRIVING WITHOUT A LICENSE. 

Estrada-Martinez has a history of motor vehicle violations, including a DWI conviction. He has a FINAL ORDER OF REMOVAL on the books, and he’s reentered the country illegally at least twice.

According to his rap sheet, he has prior arrests for:
 
—Driving without a license
—One-way-road violation
—Evading arrest
—DUI
—Felony reckless endangerment
—No proof of insurance
 
Estrada-Martinez was arrested by local police with help from ICE Knoxville officers. ICE issued an immigration detainer to prevent his release into the community — regardless of the outcome of this case.

On June 15, 2026, ICE law enforcement officers were conducting a targeted vehicle stop in Manahawkin, New Jersey to arrest Freidrich Castillo-Ormeno, an illegal alien from Peru who was released into our country under the Biden administration. He was given a final order of removal by an immigration judge on January 30, 2026. 

ICE law enforcement officers attempted to conduct a vehicle stop. The driver then weaponized his vehicle and struck an officer resulting in the officer discharging his weapon. The driver fled the scene and remains at-large.

The injured officer has been transported to a local hospital for treatment. The FBI and local authorities are on the scene. This is a developing situation, and we will update the public when more information is available.

There is a pattern of vehicle attacks against our officers. Our law enforcement officers are facing a 3,300% increase in vehicle attacks against them.
